summary: Test-only change: no files under src/, package.json, index.html or public/ changed, so nothing new ships in the app bundle (src/ references tests only in a comment; vite build entry is index.html -> src). New code is e2e/play-money.spec.ts, e2e/support/play-money.ts, e2e/support/screen-list.ts, tests/ui/*.test.ts and docs. File reads are fixed repo paths (dist/, package.json, src/ui) with no external input; no shell, eval of untrusted data, network egress beyond the localhost:4173 preview origin, secrets, or new dependencies. page.evaluate calls run test-authored functions. Regexes (OFFER, DIALOG, PROVIDER_URL) are literal alternations with at most a trailing \w* before \b, run over the locally built bundle: no catastrophic backtracking. stubReplayWords pins randomness for test determinism only; no fairness impact. No findings.
